'''Belasco''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The planet was ruled by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] and was fairly wealthy. It was home to a curious pathogen: on average, every seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]], a natural [[Water/Legends|water]]-borne [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] invaded the planet. Belasco always prepared for it, stockpiling water for usage while its scientists contained the bacteria.

Prior to [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Belasco was the nexus of several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] in the [[Exploitation Region]], among them the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']]. Around [[16,800 BBY]], the planet was [[Siege of Belasco|besieged]] during the [[First Alsakan Conflict]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] was a paramilitary group associated with the planet, and during the [[Kymoodon Era]] were involved in the defense of colonies [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Among these actions was their defense of [[Parcovey Minor]] against an [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|assault]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] on the planet.<ref name="ZotR">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], it was a target of the [[Krath Holy Crusade]] as [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith]] moved to cut [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] in half.<ref name="TEA" /> Following the conclusion of the war in [[3996 BBY]], Belasco ceased to be a crossroads for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lanes.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Note">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' implies this to be due to the decline of the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] after the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] of the star of the [[Kyyr system]] and the formation of the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]] around this date. Belasco ceases to be shown as a hyperspace nexus on the Atlas' maps after this time.</ref>

Belasco remained beautiful and wealthy. It fought a war with a neighboring planet in [[142 BBY/Legends|142 BBY]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], its [[Senator/Legends|senator]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was the highly respected [[Uta S'orn]]. While she was in office, a bio-plague was introduced into the planet's [[Water/Legends|water]] supply by [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. This new bacteria created by Zan Arbor was different to the plague normally experienced by Belasco, for it multiplied at every chance to contain it. Uta S'orn's complicity in the plot and her patronage of Arbor were exposed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
